title: RAW: Refusal Aversion in the Wild, A Causal Measurement Method for Deployed LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.21641v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deployed LLMs field hundreds of millions of conversations a day and refuse a non-trivial fraction of user requests, yet the user-side cost of refusal, whether users disengage and by how much, is unmeasured on any production model: a blind spot for the consumer-facing platforms built on them. A/B-testing refusal is ethically and operationally constrained on frontier-lab products and unavailable to third-party platforms deploying these models through a fixed API. We introduce RAW, a method that uses LLM stochasticity as a natural experiment: at near-identical prompts in any existing log, the same model sometimes refuses and sometimes does not, and that variation identifies the causal user-side effect of refusal. Applying the method to 15 deployed LLMs in LMSYS-Chat-1M and WildChat, with user-clustered inference, we find that for about half of the models we can measure precisely, a refusal costs 3 to 17 pp of subsequent re-engagement; the

translated_title: RAW：现实场景中的拒答回避——一种针对已部署大语言模型的因果测量方法
translated_abstract: 已部署的大语言模型每天处理数亿次对话，并会拒绝相当一部分用户请求，然而拒答给用户侧带来的代价——即用户是否会因此流失以及流失程度——在任何生产模型上都未曾被测量过，这对建立在这些模型之上的面向消费者的平台而言是一个盲区。在前沿实验室产品上进行拒答的A/B测试在伦理和运营层面均受限制，而对于通过固定API部署这些模型的第三方平台来说更是无法实现。我们提出了RAW方法，利用大语言模型的随机性作为自然实验：在任何现有对话日志中，面对几乎相同的提示，同一模型有时拒答、有时不拒答，这种变化使得我们能够识别拒答对用户侧行为的因果效应。将该应用于LMSYS-Chat-1M和WildChat数据集中的15个已部署大语言模型，并采用用户聚类推断，我们发现对于约一半可精确测量的模型，一次拒答会导致后续用户再参与率下降3至17个百分点。
tldr: 本文提出RAW方法，利用大语言模型在相同提示下有时拒答有时不拒答的随机性作为自然实验，首次对已部署模型的拒答进行因果测量，发现一次拒答会使约一半被测模型的用户后续再参与率下降3至17个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RAW, a causal measurement method that exploits LLM stochasticity (the same model sometimes refusing and sometimes not on near-identical prompts) as a natural experiment, finding that refusal costs 3 to 17 percentage points of subsequent user re-engagement for about half of the 15 deployed LLMs measured.
